crossRefs.note: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which…
“Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond…
If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done…
So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

translations.web: If you will fear Yahweh, and serve him, and listen to his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of Yahweh, then both you and also the king who reigns over you are followers of Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: If you fear the LORD and serve Him and obey His voice, and if you do not rebel against the command of the LORD, and if both you and the king who rules over you follow the LORD your God, then all will be well.
translations.kjv: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:
translations.asv: If ye will fear Jehovah, and serve him, and hearken unto his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of Jehovah, and both ye and also the king that reigneth over you be followers of Jehovah your God, well:
